analysis:
Reviewed unit 0 against the replayed metadata, patches and changelog source. The supplied changes are documentation: changelog.d/overlapped-weight-verification.md:3–9 describes threaded read/hash overlap for registration, download, prefetch and cache-enabled model loads; docs/reference/configuration.md:621–625 (head patch) specifies 4 MiB read-ahead with two page-aligned buffers per hashed file, retaining uncached reads and existing fallbacks. Neither file changes an executable control or claims new serving authorization. No independently supported security regression or material threat-model mismatch is established.
The relevant contracts are weight integrity (A-004, T-012, T-027), cache model-identity binding (T-041/TB-007), and resource availability. Existing model-substitution limitations in TB-003 are not new findings. These documentation changes do not establish changes to attestation, authorization, encryption, plaintext exposure, credentials or billing.
Material uncertainty remains: the WeightHasher.hashSingleFileUncached and OverlappedFileDigest implementations are not supplied, and replay is incomplete (two units omitted). Further review must verify ordered, complete hashing; exclusive buffer ownership and synchronization; short-read, EOF and error handling; worker retirement; bounded thread/memory concurrency; and unchanged fallback and fresh pre/post-load verification behavior. The claimed unchanged digests and cache identity contracts cannot be validated from documentation alone. This response covers the supplied evidence, not the entire implementation or PR.
